description: Premium panel, Muad's roster (2026-09-22): OpenAI GPT-6 Astra, Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1, Google Gemini 3.8 Flash, Meta Muse Spark 1.2, Qwen 3.8 Max, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Z.ai GLM-5.3 - seven labs, same stages and external Claude-role seats as plan-open-7. Criteria move to Mistral Medium 3.5, which holds no panel seat, because Meta now votes. No Kimi K3, no xAI. Each seat carries a persona (debate stage only; see PERSONAS.md): the five defaults plus Hypatia and Avicenna via COUNCIL_PERSONAS_FILE. Several times the cost of plan-open-7: price with `npm run dry` and get an explicit go first. Decision records and whole alternative architectures on (2026-09-23): each lab blind-proposes one whole architecture before the skeleton, the labs debate them, and the plan's Decisions section records why the losers lost.
